content: Which agency produced the most in-force policies?

name: query_salesforce

content:
[Lakefront Brokerage Partners](/lightning/r/001aj000040t1nqAAA/view) produced the most in-force policies: **43**, worth **$1,110,598** in annual premium.

| Agency | In-force policies | Annual premium |
|---|---|---|
| [Lakefront Brokerage Partners](/lightning/r/001aj000040t1nqAAA/view) | 43 | $1,110,598 |
| [Prairie State Insurance Agency](/lightning/r/001aj000040t1npAAA/view) | 22 | $280,965 |
| [Driftless Insurance Group](/lightning/r/001aj000040t1nrAAA/view) | 20 | $171,174 |

Another **38** in-force policies ($165,874) have no agency listed as producer. They may have been sold direct, but the records don't say.
